description: A PHP trait providing methods for accessing and managing revision log and ownership information for Drupal content entities.

classes.name: RevisionLogEntityTrait
classes.description: A trait for managing revision log metadata and ownership for Drupal entities.

methods.name: revisionLogBaseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Defines base fields for revision creation time, user, and log message, with validation for entity type.

methods.name: getRevisionCreationTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the current revision was created.

methods.name: setRevisionCreationTime
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp for the current revision.

methods.name: getRevisionUser
methods.description: Retrieves the user entity who authored the current revision.

methods.name: setRevisionUser
methods.description: Sets the user entity as the author of the current revision.

methods.name: getRevisionUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID of the revision author.

methods.name: setRevisionUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID for the revision author.

methods.name: getRevisionLogMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the log message associated with the revision.

methods.name: setRevisionLogMessage
methods.description: Sets the log message for the revision.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the entity type definition.
